name: hcapp_findRunForTrack
description: Which run does an imported GPX file belong to (E5.F5.S6)? Given a track's first and last point times (UTC) and its first point's position, returns the runs that started between three hours before the first point and the last point, nearest start first, with the distance from each run's recorded start to that first point, whether the caller already has a PackTrack trail on it, and their attendance state. The app applies the rule: a run with a recorded location must be within a mile; one with no location is accepted on time alone after the user confirms. Server-side because the phone only holds runs for followed kennels and the last ten days.

parameters.name: firstPointUtc
parameters.description: Capture time of the track's first point, UTC.

parameters.name: lastPointUtc
parameters.description: Capture time of the track's last point, UTC. Must not precede firstPointUtc.

rowsets.name: CandidateRuns
rowsets.description: Up to 10 runs whose EventStartDateTimeGmt lies in [firstPointUtc - 3h, lastPointUtc], nearest start to the first point first. Empty when nothing started in the window.

columns.name: eventId
columns.description: HC.Event.id — the Table Storage partition key, lowercased by the app.

columns.name: eventStartLocal
columns.description: Local wall-clock start (spurious offset stripped) for display.

columns.name: hasLocation
columns.description: 1 when the event has a recorded, non-zero Latitude/Longitude.

columns.name: distanceMeters
columns.description: Metres from the event's recorded start to the track's first point; NULL when hasLocation = 0.

columns.name: existingTrackPoints
columns.description: The caller's HasherEventMap.TrackPointCount on this run (0 when none) — a track already exists when > 0.

columns.name: attendenceState
columns.description: The caller's attendance state on this run (0 when no row).

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
